# MockCore

> Shared foundation for a family of native-Swift mock servers used in UI-test automation. One
> `MockHost` binds one localhost port and routes to any number of registered `MockService`s
> (GraphQL via MockQL, REST via MockREST, or your own), which share one transactional
> in-memory `StateStore` and one deterministic data-generation system.

Swift 6.3+, SPM package with two libraries: `MockCore` (portable, NIO-free: MockValue,
StateStore, generators, seed primitives, diagnostics) and `MockCoreTransport` (SwiftNIO
MockHost + MockService seam). Test-time tool only. Most apps should depend on a protocol
extension, not on this package directly.

## Protocol extensions

- [MockQL](https://github.com/AlexNachbaur/mockql-swift): GraphQL (queries, mutations, graphql-transport-ws subscriptions)
- [MockREST](https://github.com/AlexNachbaur/mockrest-swift): REST / OpenAPI 3.0-3.1

## Reference

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockcore-swift/main/README.md): overview, composition example, writing your own extension
- [Platform architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockrest-swift/main/docs/design/architecture.md): module topology, the MockService seam, settled design decisions
- [API documentation](https://swiftpackageindex.com/AlexNachbaur/mockcore-swift/documentation): DocC for both modules
